name: std::chrono::weekday::operator+=, std::chrono::weekday::operator-=
intro:
Adds or subtracts d.count() from the weekday value, reducing the result modulo 7 to an integer in the range [0, 6].

1) Performs *this = *this + d;.

2) Performs *this = *this - d;.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A reference to this weekday after modification.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: After a call to one of these functions, ok() is always true if no overflow occurred during the operation.

examples.output: true true true true true true
